title: CloudFront KeyValueStore coverage
intro: Every CloudFront KeyValueStore data-plane operation the emulator advertises, and
what Emuplane does with it. A separate `cloudfront-keyvaluestore` SDK service
(REST/JSON, signing name `cloudfront-keyvaluestore`); the store itself is created
on the management plane, and both planes share it by ARN.
Every mutating call sends `If-Match` with the `ETag` the previous read answered,
and the suite re-reads it before each write because one write invalidates it.
`UpdateKeys` is atomic: the whole batch is validated before anything is stored.
